reviews.review_text:
Andy
Taipei, Taiwan388 contributions
2
Solid Classics
May 2026 • Solo
The Michelin set menu at Hemispheres relied on absolute precision. Dinner started with a house bread that delivered a distinct, loud crunch. The tuna carpaccio made for a clean, bright opener. For the main course, the A5 Wagyu sirloin arrived exactly at medium. The meat retained its rich juices, while the intramuscular fat just melted. The baked oyster was decent, but heavy cheese slightly crowded out the seafood flavor. The team stayed on top of details. They refilled water glasses early and cleared the table without any fuss. While the menu sticks to a safe, classic Western template, every dish was genuinely enjoyable at a fair price.

Mobile16754013787

An Unforgettable Birthday Celebration with Top-Tier Service
May 2026 • Family
We recently chose Hemispheres for a special family dinner to celebrate my mother’s birthday, and the entire experience was absolutely flawless.
From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt incredibly luxurious. The ambiance is elegant, sophisticated, and paired with a stunning view that sets the perfect backdrop for a memorable evening or a special occasion.
The food was nothing short of amazing. Every dish was prepared beautifully, but the absolute star of the night was the T-Bone steak—perfectly cooked, incredibly juicy, and packed with flavor. It is a absolute must-try.
What truly elevated our night, however, was the world-class service. The staff here are incredibly professional and attentive. A special shoutout goes to our server, Phuong Anh, who went above and beyond to look after us. Her warmth, professionalism, and impeccable attention to detail made my mother feel incredibly special and made our family celebration seamless.
